## History

In his youth, Rudge had a log launched at him by his father. He later became a parent when his wife gave birth to multiple children at once. Rudge passed away prior to the dissolution of his household by his widow.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Nell’s History P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P32](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0032), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P67](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0067)_
